description: This file is a script for checking external links in the Mattermost web application codebase. It scans specific directories for source files, extracts URLs matching certain patterns, validates them, and performs HTTP checks to determine their accessibility, generating reports in various formats.

methods.name: getAllSourceFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans directories to collect source files with specific extensions, optionally excluding test files.

methods.name: extractUrls
methods.description: Reads a file and extracts all URLs matching the Mattermost URL pattern.

methods.name: findAllMattermostUrls
methods.description: Aggregates all Mattermost URLs found across specified directories and source files.

methods.name: isValidPermalink
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches valid permalink or domain patterns.

methods.name: findNonPermalinkUrls
methods.description: Identifies URLs that do not conform to permalink patterns.

methods.name: checkUrl
methods.description: Performs an HTTP HEAD request with retries to check URL accessibility.

methods.name: checkUrlWithRedirects
methods.description: Follows redirects up to a maximum limit to verify URL response status.

methods.name: processResponse
methods.description: Processes HTTP response to determine if URL is accessible, redirected, or broken.

methods.name: shouldSkipUrlCheck
methods.description: Determines if a URL should be skipped from checking based on pattern.

methods.name: checkUrls
methods.description: Checks multiple URLs concurrently, respecting a specified concurrency limit.

methods.name: printResults
methods.description: Outputs the results of URL checks in a human-readable format with color coding.

methods.name: generateMarkdownSummary
methods.description: Creates a markdown formatted summary report of URL check results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates URL scanning, checking, and reporting based on command-line arguments.
